summary: This image shows a retrospective/collaborative tool interface (likely a digital whiteboard or team retrospective platform) featuring a "Start, Stop, Continue" framework. It contains no biotech, scientific, or TRL-relevant content — only UI elements, input fields, and usage tips for a facilitated team reflection session.

content_blocks.title: Start / Stop / Continue Retrospective Tool UI
content_blocks.content: The image displays a three-column retrospective interface with a 5-minute 4-second timer. Columns are: 'Start' (What new behaviors should we adopt?), 'Stop' (What existing behaviors should we cease doing?), and 'Continue' (What current behaviors should we keep doing?). Each column has a text input area. Tip boxes at the bottom read: 'Collapse the sidebar if you need more room to work', 'A highlighted column means your facilitator wants you to focus on that area', and 'Click the ? in the bottom bar for more tips'. No scientific, experimental, or biotech content is present.

key_findings: This document is a team retrospective/collaboration tool UI screenshot with no scientific, experimental, or biotech content relevant to TRL assessment.
